metric: normalized-y-distance, span floor 5% of linear y axis (design 7.66)
point_metric: point-level recall/precision/F1 of marker positions, axis-range-normalized (log axes in log10), one-to-one Hungarian per series pair (count of pairs within tau maximized), series assigned by 1 - F1_tau; primary: macro point_f1 at tau 0.02 (design 7.67)
synthetic_note: mean_summary_score and n_figures cover the real published figures only. The synthetic fixtures are a harness self-test and are reported separately; they stay in per_figure so the self-test is auditable, but they are not part of the benchmark score.
run_environment: local NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, no Colab; torch 2.1.2+cu121, mmcv-full 1.7.2 built from source (nvcc 12.0, gcc 12.4), LineFormer's vendored mmdet 2.28.2, checkpoint iter_3000.pth -- design §7.64
calibration_note: Pixel->data mapping takes the full image frame as the plot area, the same choice as the n42 Colab run (notebooks/lineformer_colab.ipynb); raw pixel output is kept so other mappings can be rescored without re-running inference.
